role: environment traffic traces (latency generation); trains no model in this repository
upstream_dataset: 328-hour commercial-5G packet captures (Choi et al., IEEE Communications Magazine 2023), GeForce-NOW application traffic, UL and DL
contents: scm_geforce_ul_real/ and scm_geforce_dl_real/, each holding generated_traffic.csv and summary.json for one link direction
consumers: data/latency_profiles/5g_nhits_geforce.json via the 5g_repo_csv source kind; mapped to one-way latency by the queue-load model in simulation/scenarios/latency_profile.py
note: Not a tire or terrain corpus. Every learned component of the control and estimation stack is supervised by the controlled single-tire Chrono SCM rig; this generator sits outside that stack, trains no model in this repository, and touches no vehicle or terrain quantity.
